title: From Hilbert's Tenth Problem to Quantum Speedup: Explicit Oracles for Bounded Diophantine Systems
summary: Solving non-linear Diophantine systems lies at the mathematical core of integer optimization and cryptography. While the general unbounded problem is undecidable, even over bounded integer domains it remains classically intractable in the worst case. In this work, we introduce a fully reversible quantum algorithmic framework tailored to solve arbitrary polynomial Diophantine equations over bounded integer domains.
